biography: Owen 'The Blaze' Hizzey is a name synonymous with audacious overtakes and a 'never say die' attitude on the track. Hailing from a small town in Yorkshire, Owen's racing journey began with karting at the local circuit, where his raw talent was immediately evident, often bending the kart in half. His father, a former mechanic, recognized his son's inherent speed and tirelessly worked to keep Owen's kart running, even if it meant sacrificing his own free time. He quickly graduated to single-seaters, where his aggressive style and relentless pursuit of victory earned him a reputation as a formidable opponent. A defining moment came at the Brands Hatch Formula Ford Festival, where he started from the back of the grid after a qualifying shunt and fought his way to a podium finish, showcasing his exceptional racecraft. Now at the peak of his career, Owen is a leading force in the Ginetta championship, constantly pushing the limits of both himself and his machinery. He is determined to climb to the top step.
drivingStyle: Owen's driving style is characterized by fearless aggression and unwavering commitment. He's known for late braking maneuvers and daring overtakes, often threading the needle where others wouldn't dare to venture. While his aggressive style can sometimes lead to mistakes, it also makes him incredibly exciting to watch. Owen has a knack for managing tire degradation, subtly adjusting his lines and throttle input to preserve rubber without sacrificing pace. Under pressure, he thrives, often finding an extra gear when the stakes are highest.

rivalries.reason: A long-standing rivalry dating back to their karting days, fueled by contrasting driving styles and clashes on track.

careerHighlight: Winning the Ginetta Supercup championship in 2021 after a season-long battle, clinching the title with a last-lap overtake at Donington Park.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final race of the 2020 Ginetta GT4 Supercup season, losing the championship by a single point.
